title: Heroes show a real photo, masthead entries are read on their own page, and captions are never written as links
steps: S1: In the TCH checkout with dependencies installed, run run.cmd.
S2: Confirm every test named in run.tests reports ok.
expect: A hero frame tries a real photo before it is hidden; per-menu-item entries sharing one photo are each printed once on their own page; an entry frame a twin fills or no kept page prints needs no picture; a caption in an address slot is not written.

tests: a hero's frame tries a real photo of the business before it is hidden; any other frame keeps its order
a per-menu-item entry is shown only on its own page: three entries sharing one photo are each printed once
each masthead entry prints on the page whose title is its entry, and an entry no page names prints nowhere
an entry frame left empty needs no picture when a twin fills it or no kept page prints it
words the writer puts in an address slot are left out, never written as a link to a page that does not exist
